galleries.name: Murphy
galleries.description: Murphy was developed during the 2024–2025 season. It earned its name after all the unexpected twists and challenges we faced at the Maryland competition in June 2025, a true nod to Murphy’s Law. Despite a chaotic and demanding week, the car carried us through and became part of some unforgettable team memories. Murphy truly proved its strength later that year at Oktobajafest in October, where we proudly secured 2nd place in both the SNT and Endurance events.
